mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.25%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic economic recovery, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and demand for goods, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200 during the post-pandemic recovery, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals strong demand for residential construction, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signal a healthy supply chain and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO growth and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a decline in the core inflation rate signals easing price pressures, which reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
